reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) does not address pack cementation aluminizing, alumina scale formation on HfNbTaTiZr, or the effect of such a treatment on mechanical properties. E1 discusses laser additive manufacturing of other HEAs, and E2 describes arc-melting of Ti–Zr–Nb–O alloys; neither provides any support for the key premises.
premises: Pack cementation aluminizing can be applied to refractory high-entropy alloys to form an Al-rich interlayer
The Al-rich interlayer oxidizes to a continuous, dense, adherent Al2O3 scale
An Al2O3 scale acts as an effective oxygen diffusion barrier on refractory alloys at 1000 °C
The aluminizing treatment does not degrade the alloy's room-temperature ductility (8–16%)
The aluminizing treatment does not degrade the alloy's high-temperature yield strength (163–530 MPa)
